title: 破碎空间旅行者
description:
Welcome all players to join our official discussion group:

Discord：Broken Space Traveler

An adventure spanning dimensions, travelers from different spaces explore endless secrets in the shattered realm. In this mysterious world, you need to collect various items to strengthen yourself, upgrade your weapons, and survive in a perilous environment.

FeaturesDiverse Characters, Strategic Survival: Dozens of travelers with unique mechanisms await your summons. Each traveler possesses their own unique survival method. Choose the role that best suits you and formulate your survival strategy!

Item Combinations, Endless Possibilities: A vast array of items to select from and freely combine, creating your unique playstyle. Each combination offers a brand-new experience, filling your adventure with limitless potential.

Weapon Upgrades, Versatile Forms: Dozens of weapons await your unlocking. Each weapon boasts three distinct upgrade paths, granting them diverse powers. Make your choice and craft your ultimate weapon!

 

Enhance Travelers, Meet Demands: By collecting items or triggering events, you can empower your travelers and fulfill weapon upgrade requirements. Continuously improve your strength during your explorations, becoming the king of the shattered space!

 

Unlock Spaces, Adjust Strategies: Surviving in the shattered space, you will gradually unlock more complete areas. Different spaces possess distinct environments and challenges. Adjust your strategies and embark on new adventures!

Join "Broken Space Traveler" now and embark on your cross-dimensional adventure!
description_short: "Broken Space Traveler" is a casual ROGUE game. Players will take on the role of travelers from different time and space, enhancing their abilities to manipulate various weapons and survive in the fragmented space.
